0.original: Minfilia wants to introduce you to an Ala Mhigan member of the Scions.

1.original: Minfilia has told you of Haribehrt, a member of the Scions hailing from Ala Mhigo. Seek him out in the storage area and solicit his assistance in your investigation.

2.original: While Haribehrt no longer has friends in the Resistance, he knows someone who does. Take yourself to Quarrymill in the South Shroud, and introduce yourself to a woman named Albreda.

3.original: Mentioning Haribehrt's name to Albreda earns you an angry outburst. Nonetheless, she relents to your request and refers you to a man named Meffrid, a captain of the Ala Mhigan Resistance.

48.original: Your Ala Mhigan comrade is named Haribehrt. He joined our cause in the hopes that he might find a way to liberate his homeland.

49.original: While he spares no effort towards that endeavor, I have no doubt that he would be glad to assist you.

50.original: If I recall correctly, Haribehrt is currently between missions. Try looking for him in the storage area.

51.original: If it isn't <hex:022903EB0203>, the Scions' rising star! Is there aught I can do for you?

52.original: You wish to win the trust of the people of Little Ala Mhigo! That is a daunting task, my friend, even for our own countrymen.

53.original: I would like nothing more than to help, but I'm afraid my name no longer carries weight with that lot.

54.original: I used to be a member of the Ala Mhigan Resistance, you see, but I left in favor of joining the Scions.

55.original: Though my allegiance may have shifted, my purpose remains ever the same─the liberation of Ala Mhigo. Yet whatever my reasons were, I abandoned my comrades, and they'll have nothing to do with me.

56.original: Now, while I may have no more friends in the Resistance, I know someone who does. Her name is Albreda, and she is a resident of Quarrymill. Say my name when you meet her, and she won't lead you astray.

57.original: Eh? You want <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103> to introduce <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> to the Resistance? Hah! Why the hells should I do that? Give me just one reason!

58.original: H-Haribehrt sent you!? Grrr, that worthless whoreson... He abandons his comrades─his <hex:021A020203>woman<hex:021A020103>─and now he has the gall to ask <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103> for a favor!? Simply incredible...

59.original: I just... I mean... <sigh> Ugh. I realize Haribehrt was only doing what he felt was right. He's a good man. And if he trusts you, then that's all I need to know. You see that bloke there? That's Meffrid, a captain of the Resistance. I hope he can give you what you need.
